# Boring Balance

> A free, open-source desktop app for tracking accounts, spending and budgets. It runs on Windows, macOS and Linux, needs no sign-up, and keeps all data in one SQLite file on the user's computer.

## What it does

- Overview of net worth, account allocation and monthly cash flow
- Transactions and transfers between the user's own accounts
- Category budgets with setup and analysis views
- Recurring transactions
- Breakdown and Compare pages for yearly and month-to-month analysis
- Backups and restore, optional folder sync, Excel import and export
- Seven interface languages, light and dark themes

## Privacy and data

- No account, no analytics, no telemetry, no hosted backend
- Data lives in a local SQLite file; backups and sync only write to folders the user chooses
- The only network request is a check for new releases on the public GitHub API, which sends none of the user's data
- It does not connect to bank accounts today; linking bank accounts is on the roadmap
